title: I2C pull-ups
summary: The two pull-up resistors every I2C bus needs exactly once.

ports.VCC: bus supply (the lower of the device supplies)

notes: Use one set per bus. Breakout modules often carry their own; several sets in parallel can add up to too strong a pull-up.
4.7 kΩ suits 100 kHz and short 400 kHz buses; use 2.2 kΩ for long wires or many devices.
